The *Tissātherīgāthā* (Thig 1.4) is a short canonical poem preserved in the *Therīgāthā* ("Verses of the Senior Nuns") within the Khuddaka Nikāya of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Ascribed to the elder nun (*therī*) Tissā, it forms the fourth entry in the single-verse section (*Ekakanipāta*) of the collection [SuttaCentral].

Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any parallels for this verse in other Buddhist traditions or canonical corpora; DharmaNexus finds no Pali-internal text reuse and no cross-language alignments with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan texts at or above score 10 [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

The text is translated into multiple modern languages, with SuttaCentral cataloging thirteen translations across ten languages, including English renderings by Bhikkhu Sujato and Ayya Soma [SuttaCentral]. None of the secondary literature matches retrieved in the research dossier address this particular composition, instead mentioning unrelated historical and canonical figures named Tissa.
